# Crew API: crew (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## GET /v1/crew/capabilities

Capability negotiation.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Available now: owner only |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | preview |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with any credential the user granted it. |

Call this first. The result is what the engine reports, filtered by the gateway for the current API version and the caller's grant; a capability the gateway cannot confirm is not reported as available. Using a feature reported as false returns 422 capability_unavailable.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: Success.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [Capabilities](schemas.md#capabilities):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_version` | object | yes | current is this Kiro Crew's Crew API minor version, for display and troubleshooting only. Clients decide what they can use from features and agents, not by comparing version numbers. |
| `features` | object | yes |  |
| `agents` | object | no |  |
| `limits` | object | no |  |
| `quota` | [Quota](schemas.md#quota) | no |  |
| `retention_days` | integer (1 to 365) | no | This crew's retention in days (30 by default). It decides how far back cursors, stream resumption and files reach. |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `token_revoked`, `third_party_disabled` | 401: invalid_token, token_revoked, third_party_disabled. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 403 | `entitlement_required`, `insufficient_scope`, `approval_requires_first_party`, `tool_not_registered`, `connector_definition_changed`, `use_responses_api`, `grant_paused` | 403: grant_paused, entitlement_required, insufficient_scope, approval_requires_first_party, tool_not_registered, connector_definition_changed, use_responses_api. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `concurrency_limit`, `quota_exhausted`, `notification_limited` | 429: rate_limited, concurrency_limit, quota_exhausted, notification_limited. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 503 | `instance_unavailable` | 503: instance_unavailable. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |

## GET /v1/crew/grant

Read the app's own grant.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with any credential the user granted it. |

Any delegated credential may call it; no extra scope is needed. It keeps answering while the grant is paused (other operations return 403 grant_paused), so the app can tell the user why it stopped. The user's own credential has no grant of its own and gets 404; all grants are listed by the Owner operation GET /v1/crew/owner/grants.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |

Response `200`: This grant's scopes, Bot range, quota, status and pause reason.

Response headers:

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `X-Request-Id` | string | One id per request, supplied by the caller or an intermediary, or generated by the gateway. Also written to the audit log and the error body. |
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | The server's minor version, for example 1.3. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Limit` | number | This grant's daily credit ceiling. Sent on every response to a delegated-credential request, success or failure; not sent for the embed credential. |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Remaining` | number | Credits left today (reservations already subtracted). |
| `X-Crew-Quota-Reset` | integer | When the quota resets, Unix seconds. |

Response body fields (`application/json`), [GrantSelf](schemas.md#grantself):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `object` | `grant` | yes |  |
| `client_id` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | `remote`, `local` | yes | remote: issued by the Kiro authorization service; local: local authorization, issued by this gateway. |
| `scopes` | array of string | yes |  |
| `entitlements` | array of [Entitlement](schemas.md#entitlement) | no |  |
| `bots` | object | no |  |
| `status` | `active`, `throttled`, `paused` | yes | After a revocation the token stops working and this object cannot be read (401 token_revoked). |
| `pause` | object or null | no | Only when paused: who paused it, a reason a person can read, and when. The app uses it to tell the user why it stopped. |
| `quota` | [Quota](schemas.md#quota) | no |  |
| `memory_global` | boolean | no |  |
| `created_at` | [Timestamp](schemas.md#timestamp) | yes | Unix seconds. |

Errors. The response body is [Error](schemas.md#error); its `error.code` field holds the code.

| Status | Codes | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `invalid_token`, `token_revoked`, `third_party_disabled` | 401: invalid_token, token_revoked, third_party_disabled. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 403 | `entitlement_required`, `insufficient_scope`, `approval_requires_first_party`, `tool_not_registered`, `connector_definition_changed`, `use_responses_api`, `grant_paused` | 403: grant_paused, entitlement_required, insufficient_scope, approval_requires_first_party, tool_not_registered, connector_definition_changed, use_responses_api. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 404 | `not_found`, `model_not_found` | 404: not_found, model_not_found. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 429 | `rate_limited`, `concurrency_limit`, `quota_exhausted`, `notification_limited` | 429: rate_limited, concurrency_limit, quota_exhausted, notification_limited. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
| 500 | `internal_error` | 500: internal_error. Carries X-Crew-Quota-* on delegated-credential requests. |
